_comment: CI budget for scripts/perf/check-budget.mjs: the #765 targets plus 20% headroom for CI noise (bench at --cpu-throttle 4 --swipes 20). Targets: GitHub issue 765 (the React UI tracking issue). min_count is the fewest samples a metric may have: below it the check fails, so a bench that dropped swipes cannot pass on one sample. A metric with min_count 0 and no samples is reported as skipped.
